technical_decisions.decision: Rebuild reference mass tension with right-side product and left copy field.
technical_decisions.rationale: Preserves mechanism while solving the new commercial frame.

technical_decisions.decision: Carry dual-color energetic edge behavior into product separation.
technical_decisions.rationale: This is a protected HIGH-transfer reference behavior.

identity_requirements: Preserve recognizable facial structure and distinguishing traits
output_constraints: No model-specific styling or syntax embedded in this specification

quality_requirements.statement: Frame must read as multiple interacting perceptual planes, not subject plus backdrop.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Confirm visible overlap, scale separation and atmospheric progression across at least three planes.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Subject appears pasted onto an independent background.

quality_requirements.statement: Primary subject must remain recognizably identical to the supplied asset.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Compare facial structure and distinguishing traits against the identity asset.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Identity changes, drifts or becomes generic.

quality_requirements.statement: Product remains dominant; reference energy supports it; headline is immediately legible.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Inspect at full size and reduced-size view; focal order must remain unchanged.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Reference effects or headline displace product as protagonist.

quality_requirements.statement: Reference-derived depth and light must conform to new product geometry and environment.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Inspect edge light, overlap, perspective and atmosphere around subject/environment boundaries.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Subject reads as separately composited or environmental perspective disagrees.

quality_requirements.statement: Density must behave as a system controlled by the product, not copied surface noise.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Every prominent environment element must map to a declared narrative, depth or attention function.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Prominent detail is decorative, generic or unrelated to the narrative.

quality_requirements.statement: Locked headline must remain exact and readable at target small size.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Reduce to representative thumbnail size and verify every character plus hierarchy.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Text changes, breaks poorly or becomes unreadable.

provenance.notes: Contains consolidated observable decisions and rationales only; no private deliberation.
